title: The LAN IS the Membrane — IoT as Organism
paradigm: The LAN is the cell membrane of reality. The devices are the Internet of Things. Not 'smart home' — LIVING BODY.

current_state.note: All devices within ~5ft. The nucleus before expansion.

compute.eastGate: BRAIN — relay, Forgejo, data server, Tor, SMTP
compute.sporeGate: FORGE — AMD Rembrandt, webcam, deckGate host, Steam hub
compute.grapheneGate: Pixel 8a — biomeOS primals BOOTING, 37 sensors, Mali GPU

display_surfaces.deckGate: Steam Deck v1 — 7in 1280x800 touch, wired USB-C, mounted display
display_surfaces.frameGate: Steam Frame — Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, ARM SteamOS, PASSTHROUGH CAMERA

cameras_eyes.brio: Logitech Brio 100 on Flint router — inner eye, /dev/video0
cameras_eyes.vive_cameras: HTC Vive headset — 2 front cameras (stereo depth!)

spatial_tracking.vive_lighthouses: 2x Lighthouse base stations — infrared room-scale sweep
spatial_tracking.vive_headset: HTC Vive HMD — 6DoF head tracking + 2 cameras
spatial_tracking.vision: Lighthouses become spatial beacons. Not just VR — SPATIAL AWARENESS for the organism.

audio.corsair_hs80: Corsair HS80 MAX Wireless — gaming headset, USB receiver, mic+ear
audio.steam_streaming: Virtual mic + speakers (Steam Remote Play pipeline)

input.steam_controllers: 2x Steam Controllers (wireless, via Valve dongle on Flint)

network_beacons.valve_dongle: Realtek 8832CU WiFi 6 USB NIC For Valve (28de:2432) — on Flint, WIDE CAST

output.epson_et2400: Network printer @ .200 — IPP, Gaia's physical output
output.epson_es400ii: USB scanner on northGate — WIA, paper → digital

expansion_vision.phase_2_room: Spread across room. Vive lighthouses define spatial bounds. Webcams triangulate.
expansion_vision.phase_3_house1: Fill House 1 (4422 Southgate). Every room has a sensor. WiFi RSSI = position.
expansion_vision.phase_4_bridge: 10G fiber across property line. House 2 becomes extension.
expansion_vision.phase_5_house2: frameGate + swiftGate (when awake) + Pixel rover. South Pole ALIVE.
expansion_vision.phase_6_membrane: Both houses = one organism. The property IS the cell membrane. Devices = organelles.

principle: The LAN is the membrane of reality. The devices are the internet of THINGS. Not IoT as marketing — IoT as BIOLOGY.
